macros.name: qFV
macros.doc: The verses are typeset using the \qFV command (quiz-Fetch-Verse) for a quiz and the \sFV command (short-quiz-Fetch-Verse) for a short-quiz.

macros.name: RBTWidth
macros.doc: The command \RBTWidth is the width of the \RespBoxTxt control; its default value is \setRBTWidthTo{AA}.

macros.name: setRBTWidthTo
macros.doc: For \setRBTWidthTo, ⟨content⟩ is any text; it is measured to determine its width and the width becomes the expansion of \RBTWidth.

macros.name: sFP
macros.doc: The passages themselves are typeset using the \qFP command (quiz-Fetch-Passage) for a quiz and the \sFP command (short-quiz-Fetch-Passage) for a short-quiz.

macros.name: sFV
macros.doc: The verses are typeset using the \qFV command (quiz-Fetch-Verse) for a quiz and the \sFV command (short-quiz-Fetch-Verse) for a short-quiz.

macros.name: useNumbersOff
macros.doc: The command \useNumbersOn turns on numbering (within the Bblpsg environment only), while \useNumbersOff turns off numbering.

macros.name: useNumbersOn
macros.doc: The command \useNumbersOn turns on numbering (within the Bblpsg environment only), while \useNumbersOff turns off numbering.

envs.name: BblPsg
envs.doc: The passages are entered in the BblPsg (Bible Passages) environment.

envs.name: BblVrs
envs.doc: The verse references are entered into the BblVrs (Bible Verses) environment.
